notes:
What's new in 0.1.139:
- Live TV: if a channel has not started after 25 seconds, the player now stops and says so plainly, with a Try again button. It used to show "Tuning..." for 40 seconds. The Live TV page in a browser waits the same 25 seconds.
- Music: the Now playing bar has a Previous song button (the keyboard media key works too). More than 5 seconds into a song it starts the song again; otherwise it goes to the song before, and on the first song it starts it again. The Music page also lists your albums; pick one and its songs play in order.
- Favourites: a saved favourite now shows the title Beebo found for the film or show (for example "11.22.63") instead of a title guessed from the file name. The file name is used only when no title was found.
- Restart Beebo after logging out: Beebo now comes back on the sign-in form instead of the Welcome screen, when this computer is already set up and no Beebo account is signed in.
- Away-from-home access paused by Beebo support: Beebo now shows a banner with the reason Beebo support gave, and stops offering the away-from-home address, its Copy button and QR code in Settings, the connection test, Get Started and the Jellyfin address list. Watch Together invites use a home link instead. Watching on your home Wi-Fi is unchanged.
- Browser: TV show pages now call season 0 "Specials" instead of "Season 00". The word is translated into the six shipped languages.
- Browser: the Family viewing button in the sidebar now works in a browser; before, it stayed hidden. Guests, restricted profiles and linked TVs can see the setting but cannot switch it.
- Browser layout: bigger tap targets on the library pages, the player top bar and the Live TV tabs; the "+" next to an episode sits at the end of its row; the Photos page title names the page; on a phone, the signed-in devices table and the Appearance variables tables no longer push the page sideways.
- Browser player: the Pre-show button, its tooltip and the Phone speakers instructions are now translated.
- Settings search: finds the "Start Beebo when I sign in to Windows" switch with phrases such as "run at startup", "launch on login" or "open when Windows starts", and skips small joining words in every full language (for example German "mit Windows starten").
- Under the hood: small updates to the libraries the app is built with (React, Vite, nodemailer). Electron and the installer builder are unchanged.
- Windows only. The phone app and Beebo Auto are separate releases.
- Automated checks: the full Windows desktop test suite was run on the release source (2,164 test files, 22,145 tests): 21,999 passed and 0 failed; 109 tests in 34 files were skipped, so they were not run (mostly checks that need Linux, file links, an optional browser package or an opt-in switch), and 37 are marked as future work. Two files first stopped because the test computer ran out of memory, and passed when run again on their own. The signed installer passed its signature, size, converter, connection-helper and language checks. No person has installed 0.1.139 yet, so its changes and its in-app update from 0.1.138 have not been tried by a person.
- Release source commit 1d83943b3.
- Built: Nov 23, 2026, 9:07 AM Eastern.
